# Substratal Apps — Platform API

> Substratal Apps is the user/organization/tenancy/settings/storage layer an
> app developer would otherwise have to build themselves — comparable in
> shape to Auth0, Clerk, or WorkOS, scoped around everything a multi-tenant
> app needs: accounts, roles and permissions, per-app settings, team/tenancy
> structure, and per-user storage, all behind one API. This site is the
> system of record for that API: users, roles, per-app access (the "turn an
> app on/off for a user" switch), profiles, and settings across every
> Application built on the platform. It is API-first: no user-facing
> interface is specified here — a dashboard for easier onboarding is
> planned, but it is a separate, later client of this API. Billing is each
> Application developer's own concern; this API tracks entitlement state,
> it does not process payments.

This site is the living specification. Treat it as authoritative over any
older single-file draft found elsewhere in the repository's history.

## Start here

- [Home](https://adron.github.io/substratalapps.com/versions/1.2.1/): what Substratal Apps is and how this site is organized.
- [Getting Started](https://adron.github.io/substratalapps.com/versions/1.2.1/getting-started/): the fastest path to understanding the system before writing code against it.
- [Quickstart](https://adron.github.io/substratalapps.com/versions/1.2.1/quickstart/): a runnable curl walkthrough of the core access model.
- [Domain Model](https://adron.github.io/substratalapps.com/versions/1.2.1/domain-model/): the entities — User, Organization, Tenant, Application, Role, Permission, Entitlement, Profile, Setting, Order, Audit Event.
- [Tenancy](https://adron.github.io/substratalapps.com/versions/1.2.1/domain-model/tenancy/): the infrastructure-placement/data-isolation boundary for an Application owner — shared, isolated, or dedicated-region. Distinct from Organization.
- [Access Control](https://adron.github.io/substratalapps.com/versions/1.2.1/access-control/): how Entitlement (is the app on?) and Role (what can they do?) combine to decide every request, including Organization-vs-User precedence when an org-wide grant and a User's own standing could otherwise conflict.
- [Database Schema](https://adron.github.io/substratalapps.com/versions/1.2.1/domain-model/database-schema/): Postgres types, constraints, and indexes behind every entity — for implementers, not API callers.

## API reference

- [Conventions](https://adron.github.io/substratalapps.com/versions/1.2.1/api-reference/conventions/): base URL, auth, pagination, idempotency, error shape, ID format.
- [Auth](https://adron.github.io/substratalapps.com/versions/1.2.1/api-reference/auth/): signup, login, MFA, sessions, password/email lifecycle, and how an Application obtains its per-app JWT.
- [Users](https://adron.github.io/substratalapps.com/versions/1.2.1/api-reference/users/)
- [Profiles](https://adron.github.io/substratalapps.com/versions/1.2.1/api-reference/profiles/)
- [Settings](https://adron.github.io/substratalapps.com/versions/1.2.1/api-reference/settings/)
- [Applications](https://adron.github.io/substratalapps.com/versions/1.2.1/api-reference/applications/)
- [Entitlements](https://adron.github.io/substratalapps.com/versions/1.2.1/api-reference/entitlements/): the on/off switch for a user's access to an app.
- [Roles & Permissions](https://adron.github.io/substratalapps.com/versions/1.2.1/api-reference/roles-and-permissions/)
- [Organizations](https://adron.github.io/substratalapps.com/versions/1.2.1/api-reference/organizations/)
- [Tenancy](https://adron.github.io/substratalapps.com/versions/1.2.1/api-reference/tenancy/): fetch a Tenant and request a tier change — support-only today, no customer self-service.
- [Billing](https://adron.github.io/substratalapps.com/versions/1.2.1/api-reference/billing/): the Application owner's own Substratal subscription — plan, usage, Stripe Checkout and Customer Portal.
- [Audit](https://adron.github.io/substratalapps.com/versions/1.2.1/api-reference/audit/)
- [Webhooks](https://adron.github.io/substratalapps.com/versions/1.2.1/api-reference/webhooks/)
- [API Keys](https://adron.github.io/substratalapps.com/versions/1.2.1/api-reference/api-keys/): service-to-service credentials.
- [openapi.yaml](https://adron.github.io/substratalapps.com/versions/1.2.1/openapi.yaml): the same API surface as a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 document.

## Also useful

- [Workflows](https://adron.github.io/substratalapps.com/versions/1.2.1/workflows/): purchase-to-access, admin revokes access, role changes, end to end.
- [Trust Model](https://adron.github.io/substratalapps.com/versions/1.2.1/trust-model/): how a separately-hosted downstream app verifies a user's access against this API.
- [MCP Server](https://adron.github.io/substratalapps.com/versions/1.2.1/mcp-server/): a Model Context Protocol server that lets an AI agent call this API as tools, generated from openapi.yaml, using the same Bearer credential as every other caller — no new auth model.
- [Non-Functional Requirements](https://adron.github.io/substratalapps.com/versions/1.2.1/non-functional-requirements/)
- [Compliance & Data Protection](https://adron.github.io/substratalapps.com/versions/1.2.1/compliance/): which of SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, and CCPA apply, and when.
- [Roadmap](https://adron.github.io/substratalapps.com/versions/1.2.1/roadmap/): MVP through Phase 3.
- [Pricing](https://adron.github.io/substratalapps.com/versions/1.2.1/pricing/): Starter (free), Team (per-seat), and Enterprise (with a choice of Tenant tier) — what Substratal itself charges the Application-owner developer, distinct from what that developer charges their own end users.
- [Changelog](https://adron.github.io/substratalapps.com/versions/1.2.1/changelog/): what's changed in this spec over time.
- [Glossary](https://adron.github.io/substratalapps.com/versions/1.2.1/glossary/)
- [Versions](https://adron.github.io/substratalapps.com/versions/1.2.1/versions/): every released version of this spec; older versions are frozen copies under `/versions/<version>/`.

Deployment/infrastructure, the build plan, and other project-planning material are intentionally not part of this API-specification site — they live as plain Markdown in the repository root at https://github.com/Adron/substratalapps.com, starting from its README.md.
